title: The Dauphine ragtime contest and New Orleans piano players
summary: He describes a ragtime piano contest at the Dauphine theater, its winner, and how loosely organised New Orleans entertainers were.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: thing was that the that the the Dauphine theater as I said they had a ragtime contest one time that was a contest that was won incidentally by a player that that I didn't think was the best ragtime player but he he played a very a very popular thing in that they played Dixie with one hand and something else with the other hand you know that the entertainers rag really is what what it is it's a very good rag part of it is Dixie with one hand and something else with the other hand two two well-known pieces and he won the contest the Claire played there and and so did kid Ross I don't remember the other players but they were a half a dozen or so how were the contests run a single number or two or three well no they they sat around in a sort of a large semicircle or on two sides the contestants and then they'd announce one and he would get up and play his particular specialty and then sit down and they they would judge it by the applause I guess as I recollect I went to see it and that was how it turned out but Claire I think the Claire as far as regular playing goes and then I was going to be kid Ross was a better ragtime player not as flashy and he couldn't play anything struck in the stage reality also but anyhow they they were they were piano players all over town you could hardly go to a party but watch them hear piano players and I was particularly interested in them because I used to pretend to play a little bit myself but not too much but what would it not too well would the contest be a one-time
